item.title: The CSTO Collective Forces continue to receive state-of-the-art weapons and equipment
item.description: The CSTO Collective Forces continue to receive state-of-the-art weapons and equipment Much attention was traditionally paid to improving operational and combat readiness of the collective security system forces and their equipment. Several large-scale joint exercises were held in Belarus, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan and, of course, Russia. <...> Today, we will need to make some important decisions on the further development of the CSTO Collective Forces. This includes their air component and the establishment of mobile air defence units for joint military operations, Vladimir Putin emphasised at an expanded-format meeting of the CSTO Security Council.

item.title: 💬 'We hit everything that moves' A drone operator of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces described his combat work in Druzhkovka direction.
item.description: 'We hit everything that moves' 💬 A drone operator of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces described his combat work in Druzhkovka direction. 🎮 According to the serviceman, our drone operators engage every target without exception: 'We hit infantry, motor vehicles, Baba Yaga drones. Basically, anything that moves, we hit it'. 👉 As the operator himself admits, the nerves of the first combat sorties long ago gave way to cold, precise work, where the main task is to keep improving the results. 'When you hit your first unit of hardware, it's always incredibly exciting and always memorable. Then you simply get used to it all, and it becomes like a job. You just try to do it better and better each time'. ▫️ This calm attitude to the job is what shows true professionalism. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30552

'We hit everything that moves'
💬
A drone operator of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces
described his combat work in Druzhkovka direction.
🎮
According to the serviceman, our drone operators
engage every target without exception:
'We hit infantry, motor vehicles, Baba Yaga drones. Basically, anything that moves, we hit it'.
👉
As the operator himself admits,
the nerves of the first combat sorties long ago gave way to cold, precise work,
where the main task is to keep improving the results.
'When you hit your first unit of hardware, it's always incredibly exciting and always memorable. Then you simply get used to it all, and it becomes like a job. You just try to do it better and better each time'.
▫️
This calm attitude to the job is what shows true professionalism.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. The Group's units engaged units of two mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades of the AFU, and four territorial defence brigades near Yamnoye, Olshanka, Bititsa, Pushkarevka, Stetskovka, Fotovizh, and Velikaya Rybitsa (Sumy region). 💥 In addition, in Kharkov region , strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU near Kolodeznoye, Alisovka, Izbitskoye, Velikiye Prokhody, and Sosnovka (Kharkov region). ▪️ The enemy lost up to 315 troops, 18 motor vehicles, 105-mm U.S.-made M101 howitzer, and 12 electronic warfare stations. ⏩ The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30550

❗️
The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units engaged units of two mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades of the AFU, and four territorial defence brigades near Yamnoye, Olshanka, Bititsa, Pushkarevka, Stetskovka, Fotovizh, and Velikaya Rybitsa (Sumy region).
💥
In addition,
in Kharkov region
, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU near Kolodeznoye, Alisovka, Izbitskoye, Velikiye Prokhody, and Sosnovka (Kharkov region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 315 troops, 18 motor vehicles, 105-mm U.S.-made M101 howitzer, and 12 electronic warfare stations.
⏩
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades, one airmoble brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Lesnaya Stenka, Studenok, Vasilevka (Kharkov region), Mayaki, Lozovoye, Starodubovka, and Volchiy Yar (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops, one U.S.-made HMMWV armoured vehicle, and 16 motor vehicles.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Formations of three mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one mountain assault brigade, and two assault regiments of the AFU have been hit near Vasilevskaya Pustosh, Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhkovka, Raygorodok, Nikolayevka, and Krasny Molochar (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 175 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 36 motor vehicles, one Grad MLRS, one radar station, and four electronic warfare stations.
🚩
As a result of resolute actions, the Tsentr Group of Forces liberated Shilovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
🔥
Russian elements inflicted damage
on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one air assault brigade, one assault brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, four national guard brigades, and the Azov Special Operations Brigade close to Yakovlevka, Sergeyevka, Krinitsy, Kuritsino, Zelenoye, Zolotye Prudy, Roganskoye, Andreyevka, Belozerskoye (Donetsk People's Republic), and Maliyevo (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 345 troops, six armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
👉
